topics.hook: Wipe every border off the map and redraw it by forest and desert, and the biggest country on Earth is a forest the size of Russia.
topics.angle: A real biome map as a political map: the taiga becomes a country almost exactly Russia's size, the Sahara would be the world's fifth-biggest country, and the Amazon rainforest alone would out-size every country but seven.
topics.why_now: Geoberry's biome what-if did 231K on 3.72K subscribers (62x) this month, and the same channel's whole-world redraws keep breaking out (merge with a neighbour 986K, 265x). A YouTube search finds no Short this month that redraws the real world by its biomes.
topics.map_answer: the world map's borders fade and the land recolours by biome: a dark-green belt across Canada and Russia labelled with its area, a sand-coloured block over North Africa, then a push-in on the Amazon sitting over nine countries' borders
